messages:
jun: Heads-up: starting first-pass compatibility checks for atlas-lite-3b (float16 -> int8) on dev-staging. Need quick checklist + who can own perf/regression windows?
maria: @jun I'll own functional checks. I'll run the canonical prompt set and sanity evals. ETA ~30m.
akeem: I'll do perf/latency sweep. Want baseline numbers to compare? baseline float16 (dev-stg-a): p50: 35ms p95: 180ms.
sam: Flag: watch KV cache keying — int8 path had a bug where cache lookup missed on padding tokens. I'll add a diff to runtime rules.
lauren: Share the prompt set location? I'll add a couple of regen tests for code samples.
jun: Prompt set: `s3://redwood-evals/quick_onboard/atlas-lite/sanity_v2.jsonl` use seed=42, deterministic=True. Minimal checklist I'm thinking:
- tokenization sanity
- deterministic inference (n=3)
- simple QA correctness
- formatting / JSON schema tests
- kv-cache re-use
- perf vs baseline
- log sampling for hallucinations
diego: Quick command I used:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"atlas-lite-3b-int8","prompt":"<sanity>"}' https://devstg-api.internal/v1/generate | jq '.'
```
Note: include `?stream=false` for reproducibility.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Smoke run complete — 10/10 prompts returned, but 2/10 had minor truncation at token 512. See /artifacts/2591004321-smoke.tar.gz
maria: On the two truncations: looks like truncation only when prompt + instruction > 500 tokens. Is the max_seq for int8 variant set to 512? config shows `max_seq=512` — maybe lower effective context due to kv packing.
akeem: Perf quick numbers (int8): p50 48ms p95 210ms. p95 regressed ~30ms vs float16 baseline. CPU kernel fallback spikes on long sequences. Tagging @eng-runtime.
sam: @eng-runtime FYI I opened runtime issue #4823 — `int8_attention_kernel_fallback` when seq>384 on 4090s.
lauren: Functional: deterministic n=3 passed for 9/10 prompts. The one failure was ordering of list items in JSON output (non-deterministic). Might be beam/temperature drift.
jun: Decision: hold on auto-rollout. Next steps:
- @maria expand prompt set to include long-token prompts (>600)
- @akeem run perf sweep across 3 instance types
- @sam and @eng-runtime triage kernel fallback
- @lauren add JSON-ordering eval
Target: re-check in 2 work hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
diego: Noted. I'll collect logs and attach `runtime:dump` and `nvprof` traces to the ticket.
ci-bot: ci-bot: scheduled re-run at 2591005521 (in ~20m).
